title.en: Explicit major arcs and the ten-billion certificate
title.zh: 显式主弧估计与百亿验证

description.en: Give the modeled major arcs a numerical lower bound, bound their approximation error by discrepancies in arithmetic progressions, and certify prime-log positivity through ten billion.
description.zh: 给出主弧模型的数值下界，用等差数列的偏差控制逼近误差，并验证至一百亿的素数对数卷积正性。
